facts.label: Agora e depois
facts.sub: Use am/is/are + -ing para agora e going to + verbo para depois: It’s snowing now. It’s going to be cold tonight.

facts.label: Agora
facts.sub: Para falar do que acontece agora, use am/is/are + verbo com ing: It’s snowing. The children are playing. Perguntas: What are you doing? Respostas: I’m making hot chocolate.

facts.label: Depois
facts.sub: Para falar do que vai acontecer, use going to: It’s going to be cold tonight. Para planos: I’m going to build a snowman. Depois de going to, use o verbo base.
